platform.title: RTMP and SRT ingest
platform.description: Point OBS, vMix or a hardware encoder at your ingest URL. SRT keeps the picture together when the uplink is not perfect.

platform.title: HLS delivery
platform.description: Every channel publishes an .m3u8 that plays in browsers, apps and set-top boxes without a plugin.

platform.title: Dedicated servers
platform.description: Annual plans run on hardware reserved for you, so a neighbour's traffic spike is never your problem.

platform.title: Full HD 1080p
platform.description: Send up to 1080p and we pass it through at the bitrate you set. No silent downscaling.

platform.title: Free domain and SSL
platform.description: A subdomain and certificate on every plan, your own domain on annual plans. Renewals are handled for you.

platform.title: Support that answers
platform.description: A real engineer, any hour. If your stream is down at 2am, so are we.

control.title: Live viewer count
control.description: See who is watching while you are on air, not an hour later.

control.title: One-click restart
control.description: Recycle a stuck channel without tearing down the session your viewers are on.

control.title: Health monitoring
control.description: Bitrate, FPS and connection state, sampled continuously and shown as it happens.

control.title: Analytics dashboard
control.description: Viewership and bandwidth over time, so you can see which broadcasts earned their cost.

control.title: Bandwidth meters
control.description: Track the yearly allowance against a plain progress bar. No surprise overage.

control.title: Control from your phone
control.description: Start, stop and check a channel from the Android app while you are away from the desk.

steps.title: Pick a plan
steps.description: Choose a monthly tier by concurrent viewers, or an annual package by bandwidth.

steps.title: We provision your channel
steps.description: You get an ingest URL, a stream key and an HLS playback link, usually the same day.

steps.title: Go live
steps.description: Paste the ingest URL into your encoder and hit start. The dashboard lights up immediately.
